name: search-input
title: Search input
description: A search field that ⌘K (Ctrl K) focuses from anywhere, with a clear button and a spinner while results load. On focus a Recent list opens: the arrow keys move through it, Enter searches, Delete or the round × removes a search, and Escape closes the list, then clears the text.
author: UI Stacks <https://uistacks.dev>, MIT; free component, unchanged
